title: Show Your Work
author: Infected Research / FrackLabs
notes: Costs are list-price token accounting. Classes, real_bug, severity and eng_hours are AI labels made blind to arm. As in round 1, security and safety changes are listed by category only.

spotcheck.method: 16 surviving commits with a Proof: line, 8 per arm, random.Random(20261110); four checkers x 4 commits, blind to arm, lane and the reviewer verdict. Checkers ran each Proof test with the commit's test files on the parent (expect fail) and at the commit (expect pass), in scratch worktrees with the sanitized config.
